effect.name: Wave
effect.description: Runs a sine wave through the image. Underwater levels, heat shimmer, a wobbling menu, a flag - one shader, four jobs.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Amplitude
parameter.description: How far pixels move, in texels.

parameter.name: Frequency
parameter.description: How many waves fit across the object.

parameter.name: Speed
parameter.description: How fast the wave travels when Time is animated.

parameter.name: Time
parameter.description: Animate this to move the wave.

parameter.name: Vertical
parameter.description: Off pushes pixels sideways (a flag or a heat wobble). On pushes them up and down (a wave rolling across water).

parameter.name: Clip Edges
parameter.description: On hides pixels pushed outside the object's image. Off smears the edge pixels instead, which suits a full-screen wobble.
